title: Heat Release — SNKRS Drop Hero
description: A full-bleed sneaker announcement slide that channels SNKRS app energy: oversized italic compressed type slammed across a dynamically angled product shot, anchored by a single diagonal color block and a monospaced drop-date pill.
philosophy: This template exists for the three-second scroll stop — it refuses to whisper. It borrows the visual grammar of streetwear editorial and app hero art: type that physically collides with product, and color deployed as a single surgical strike rather than a considered palette. It is built for audiences who already know the brand and need only the date, the name, and the voltage. Anything measured, balanced, or corporate would betray the moment it was made for.
goodFor: Limited-edition sneaker or apparel drop announcements
Social media story-format product reveals with a single countdown date
Hero slide in a streetwear brand lookbook deck
Pop-up event or flash-sale promotional openers
avoidFor: Chart-heavy quarterly sales or financial review decks
Multi-bullet feature comparison or spec slides
Academic research poster or seminar presentations
author: harness

examples.promptCore: Voltage and urgency over elegance — the slide should feel like a midnight launch-line wall poster caught under a strobe, raw and kinetic rather than considered. A single diagonal color strike is the only disciplined geometric element; everywhere else, oversized type physically crashes into product photography with zero deference. The mood borrows from streetwear editorial and mobile app hero art: confrontational, fast, built for the three-second scroll stop. Avoid softness, symmetry, centered balance, or any compositional move that reads as measured or corporate.

examples.layoutNotes: Full-bleed canvas with zero outer margin — product image bleeds to all four edges and a hard diagonal color stripe cuts from the lower-left quadrant to roughly mid-right, claiming about one-third of the frame as a single geometric anchor. Oversized italic compressed headline spans the full canvas width and physically overlaps the product shot, sitting in the lower two-thirds rather than above or below the image. A monospaced drop-date pill locks to the bottom-left corner, flush with the bleed edge. No header band, no rule lines, no page number — hierarchy is enforced by scale collision alone.

examples.promptCore: The slide reads like a streetwear editorial spread mid-collision — product and type refuse separation, the diagonal block acting as a kinetic wedge that keeps the eye deliberately off-balance. Mood is raw and declarative: one product truth at full volume, nothing softened or hedged. Rhythm is intentionally dense where the diagonal crowds the product, then abruptly open in the opposing quadrant — controlled tension, never clutter. Avoid measured symmetry, soft gradients, or any multi-item informational layering.

examples.layoutNotes: Full-bleed canvas, zero outer margin; the product image commands the right two-thirds, shot at a dynamic upward angle that bleeds off the top and right frame edges. A diagonal color block runs at roughly 40° from the lower-left corner, bisecting the slide and acting as the primary structural spine. One emphatic feature callout — a colorway name, material descriptor, or single bold stat — is set in oversized italic compressed type that physically overlaps both the stripe and the product image. A monospaced detail pill anchors the lower-left below the diagonal cut; no header band, no conventional page number.
